description: The user's grocery list and the meals behind it, kept by Gaurmon so they're the same in every agent and device. Each item is costed near a place for the amount needed (its own amount plus its meals'), from the cheapest flyer offer or everyday shelf price: by weight, by whole packages, multibuys per item; `price.how` says how and `approximate` when the size isn't comparable. `stops` groups items by store (at most `maxStores`, only `preferBanners` when set). `meals` lists each meal's ingredients and cost share; `mealIds` on an item says which meals need it. Unpriced items aren't counted in `totals`. Ids are for update_list and update_meals. Which stores to visit, and when, is yours to suggest.

maxStores.description: Shop at most this many stores (remembered; null clears it). The list is split across the set that prices the most items for the least.

near.description: Where to price the list. Remembered for next time; omit to use the last place.

preferBanners.description: Only these banners, e.g. ["no-frills", "food-basics"] (remembered; null clears it).

name: get_list
title: The user's grocery list
